dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Essential palatal myoclonus, caused by involuntary rhythmic contractions of the tensor veli palatini muscle producing objective tinnitus
ALTERNATIVE 1: Symptomatic palatal myoclonus due to a structural lesion in the Guillain-Mollaret triangle (e.g., hypertrophic olivary degeneration from brainstem or cerebellar stroke, demyelination, or trauma)
ALTERNATIVE 2: Focal motor seizure arising from the soft palate musculature
ALTERNATIVE 3: Hemifacial spasm with palatal involvement secondary to aberrant facial nerve regeneration
